title: A stochastic subgradient method with optimal failure exponent
summary: Fix a target accuracy $\varepsilon$, a gradient-noise level $s$, and a horizon $N$. We wish to design algorithms which minimize the probability of observing a suboptimality gap which exceeds the target accuracy, i.e., $\mathcal{E}_N = -\log \sup_{f,P} \mathbb{P}_P(f(x_A) - f_\star \ge \varepsilon)$, with the noise law $P$ known only to be sub-Gaussian.
